description: Representative in-range pressure-driven tube with moderate density, velocity, and pressure contrasts.
High-left-pressure case with a weak density contrast; retained because fixed MC is slightly more accurate.
Long-time low-right-pressure case near the lower pressure edge of the training range.
Strong pressure jump with co-directed negative velocities; the largest same-grid gain among the selected in-range cases.
Blast-like extrapolation with a 500:1 pressure ratio and a 10:1 density ratio.
Symmetric colliding streams that generate a compression-dominated central interaction.
Reversed density and pressure step; retained as an out-of-distribution same-grid failure case.
Classical Sod shock tube evaluated later than the engineering training times; retained as a familiar failure control.
